body:
## What this is

The skill copies under `skills/` in this repo are **non-governing snapshots** of the live skills (the governing text lives in the fleet's live skill homes). This PR brings the snapshots current with the live skills — Decision 4 of the codex-countermeasures follow-through (sync + keep them synced).

## Scope

- **50 skills** are present in both this repo and the live home (`~/workspace/custom-skills/`); 17 of them had drifted. This PR syncs every differing `SKILL.md` and companion file, and adds companion files that exist live but were missing here (55 files written: 16 modified, 39 added).
- **Excluded, deliberately** (recorded in the execution report):
  - `skill.yaml` (9 files) — the two homes use this filename for different purposes: live it is a local import descriptor; here it is the curated registry entry (with `title`/`category` fields the live file lacks). Overwriting would destroy registry data and flip `include_in_prompt` flags. Recommend the daily job also skip `skill.yaml`, or a separate ruling on unifying the format.
  - `subagent-driven-development/.superpowers/**` — agent-process scratch inside the live skill directory, not skill content.
  - `scrubbing-public-tree/SKILL.md` — the live file's example line carries a literal machine path (`/home/hatch/build/out`); this repo's copy already carries the generalized form. Syncing would introduce a machine path into the public tree. Fix the live example and it will sync next round.
- **Repo-only files are untouched**, including the per-skill registry `skill.yaml` files and the 13 skills with no same-name live counterpart (`archify`, `paperthin`, `ralph_loop`, …).

## Follow-up

A daily job will repeat this sync (drift → PR) so the snapshots stay current; merging this PR stays gated on the owner's word, as will the daily job's PRs.

## Known CI note

`skills/prototype/LOGIC.md` (new in this sync, copied exactly) has 2 markdownlint MD049 hits (underscore emphasis at line 54) and will flag the lint job. The clean fix is at the source: change the two underscores to asterisks in the live file, and the daily sync will carry it here. Snapshot-side deviation was not taken, to keep the copies exact.

## Verification

- `test_skill_invocation_matches_cli` (scripts/tests/test_receipts.py) — the one test that reads a repo skill copy — passes against the synced tree: the live SDD skill contains the pinned `check-receipts` invocation verbatim.
- The receipts suite's other failures in a local run are byte-identical on pristine `main` (pre-existing, environment memory floor) — not caused by this change.
